title: Specific Aims
description: State the overall objective, central hypothesis or thesis, focused aims, expected outcomes, and impact in a concise sponsor-facing narrative.

title: Significance
description: Explain the unmet need, why it matters, the evidence supporting the problem, and how the proposed work advances the sponsor's priorities.

title: Innovation
description: Describe the conceptual, methodological, technological, or implementation advances and distinguish them from current practice without unsupported claims.

title: Approach
description: Present the design, methods, analyses, milestones, risks, alternatives, rigor, feasibility, and decision points needed to accomplish each aim.

title: Human Subjects
description: Describe participants, protections, inclusion, consent, privacy, risk mitigation, monitoring, and applicable ethical or regulatory considerations.

title: Environment
description: Explain the facilities, resources, institutional support, collaborations, and operational setting that make the proposed work feasible.
